name: Weird  Corridor
detailed_description:
The Weird Corridor is a walking simulation game inspired by Yume Nikki and The Backrooms. When you enter this abandoned corridor, you find yourself trapped in an endless loop. Use your lens to break the cycle—but be careful of what lurks behind you!

Spot Anomalies + Mini-Games
In The Weird Corridor, you must meticulously search for anomalies within the corridor while staying alert to dangers behind you. Sometimes, there may be no anomalies—or multiple. Proceed with caution.

This is no simple "spot the difference" game. As you delve deeper, you may need to solve puzzles, navigate endless mazes, or play mini-games to escape the loop. Equip your lens and embark on this eerie adventure.

Immersive Walking Simulation
The game features subtle horror elements: tense music, sudden appearances of dolls, and disorienting mazes. Combined with dynamic light-and-shadow mechanics, it delivers an immersive experience.

Playtime
The game takes 30 minutes to 1 hour to complete. Note: It contains unavoidable jump scares and horror scenes. Discretion is advised for sensitive players.

short_description: Enter "Weird Corridor"! Escape horror-filled halls by spotting clues: bloodstains, shadows, eerie sounds. Strategize routes, use resources wisely. Find the exit before terror engulfs you.

English, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese, Korean
*languages with full audio support
